about: Pins for P-034 (Kids Games Development)'s close checks. Version 1.1. Changes at v1.1 (D-114): the contract pin moves to v0.4, and the frozen pin on Kriss Kross goes, as its files are P-020's now (P54, D-115). Change a pin only by a logged decision in P-034. 'frozen': files that must stay byte for byte (sha256). 'drift': what we rely on from P-020 (Family Games Launcher), pinned by git object id on its branch.
